title: Finch Circle Returns — Repurchase in the Same Merchandise Class, Questions Answered
content:
**Rule.** When Finch Circle Loyalty Program points are taken back on a refunded return, the return exchange share is none (0) when a completed purchase in the same merchandise class dated 0 to 14 calendar days after the returned unit was received has a unit price at least the returned unit's, one half (0.5) when such a purchase dated 0 to 14 days after it has a lower unit price, and the whole (1) otherwise; the latest completed purchase in that class is the one compared.

**Which purchase is compared?** The member's latest completed purchase record, by purchase date, in the same merchandise class as the returned unit, under Merchandise Purchases.

**From which day are the 14 days counted?** From the day the returned unit was received back, its returned date; a purchase on that same day is day 0.

**The latest purchase in the class is 15 days after receipt; an earlier one was 5 days after. What applies?** The latest is the one compared; at 15 days it is outside 0 to 14, so the share is the whole (1).

**A replacement costs exactly the returned unit's price?** At least the returned unit's price: share 0.

| Latest completed purchase in the same class | Unit price compared with the returned unit | Return exchange share |
|---|---|---|
| dated 0 to 14 calendar days after receipt | equal or higher | 0 |
| dated 0 to 14 calendar days after receipt | lower | 0.5 |
| dated before receipt or more than 14 days after, or none | any | 1 |

## Worked case (hypothetical)

A dress of 120.00 in Apparel, Shoes & Accessories is received back on 3 April. The member's latest completed purchase in that class is a dress of 95.00 bought on 10 April, 7 days after receipt, at a lower price: share one half.
